programme.title: 喜歡妳是妳粵普
programme.desc: 李詠藍在29歲接到電話,是把既熟悉又陌生的聲音 - 原來是她的初戀情人李芯悅 藍被邀請作悅的伴娘 藍雖猶豫,但也答應了悅的邀請 結婚前一晚,藍看着悅的背影,想起二人在中學時候一段疑幻似真的感情 2001年,二人同是高材生,就讀香港傳統名校女校 每日徘徊在聖母像下,卻因青春期的性別迷思,產生出一段不知是友情還是愛情的關係 第一次動心,第一次拖手,第一次親吻 這段感情的遺憾的是,一

programme.title: 秦頌普
programme.desc: 故事講述燕國樂師高漸離愛上秦國櫟陽公主, 但秦始皇嬴政卻將公主許配他人, 離懷恨在心, 於政的登極大典上進行報復 天子,作為一朝之主,萬民之王,黃土地上就數他最位高權高,上至將領,下至蟻民,達至敵虜,近至親友,也只是一群活在他影子下,任他擺佈的棋子罷,但再卑微的,都總有叛逆之心,任憑他們外表看來,是那樣的逆來順受

programme.title: 人民英雄粵普
programme.desc: 故事描述青年梁朝偉與黃斌因欠債而冒險搶銀行, 在行動時過份慌張而被困在銀行裏, 遂劫持人質與警方對峙不料通緝犯狄龍亦在銀行內, 他持槍控制了整個場面, 要求警方配合他的逃亡條件不料他的女友卻在最後關頭

programme.title: 50米之戀粵普
programme.desc: 自視甚高的記者餘美仁是電視台裏炙手可熱的晉升人選,為了擊敗對手,她不惜挑戰無人勝任的採訪任務-前往南方的偏僻小城,去揭露一個有機農場的重大秘密不料,餘美仁在那裏不僅遇到了豬隊友-脱線少年小達和中二少女莫莫,更發現低調隨性的農場主竟是自己的剋星-小學同學李十全小時候只要兩人相距50米以內,她就會出糗倒黴然而為了事業,餘美仁不得不和剋星擦出亦敵亦友的火花,在保持50米距離的同時,一段陰差陽

programme.title: 歲月神偷粵普
programme.desc: 羅氏一家四口,父親(影帝任達華飾)每天縫製新皮鞋,母親(吳君如飾)樂觀豁達,凡事愛出頭長子羅進一(李治廷飾)天賦驕人,文武兼備,戀上名校女生Flora(少女模特兒蔡穎恩飾)

programme.title: 青苔粵普
programme.desc: 青苔是一個胸無大志的警察,他別出心裁選了專責放蛇捉妓女,既安全又有甜頭,但改變他的卻是北姑露露青苔曾經拘捕過她,但三個月再遇上說不上是愛,青苔卻喜歡與她一起那一天,露露遇上變態嫖客,慘遭折磨

programme.title: 新紮師妹II美麗任務粵普
programme.desc: 英勇無匹的女警方麗娟與年輕才俊區海文,天天過著打情罵俏的甜美生活,羨煞旁人另一方面,娟亦被警隊高層賞識,一年之內連升三級,成為警隊傳奇娟與鍾Sir的刑事偵查部第二隊接到了一個新指令,要保護兼接待從波多里西共和國來港的華藉王妃Tasah

programme.title: 褲甲天下粵普
programme.desc: 在赤柱經營牛仔褲店之褲王王枝富為人樂觀,自認對女性心理異常瞭解王店對面開了家服裝店,女店東馬超群為一離婚婦人,二人常為生意事起衝突,後王因不欲欺負弱質女流,主動幫馬,遂成好友王因事業關係遲遲未婚,其母不斷催促他早日成家立室,此時王的女友阿MAY卻另嫁他人

programme.title: 桃姐粵普
programme.desc: 本片改編自真人真事,講述生長於大家庭梁家的少爺Roger與自幼照顧自己長大的家傭媽鍾春桃之間所發生的一段溫暖人心的主僕情故事:桃姐13歲就到梁家當媽姐,轉眼60年過去,她已伺候了梁家老少四代人梁家人有的去世,有的移民了,近十年間只剩下桃姐和梁家少爺Roger在一起生活,主僕兩人相處頗有默契但很少交流後來有一天,桃姐突然中風,Roger把她送去安養院,由此展開了一段觸動人心的主僕情

programme.title: 喜愛夜蒲粵普
programme.desc: 蘭桂坊常客Steven遇上空姐Jennifer,二人發生一夜情但他們感覺今次真的戀愛了,可惜因為誤會令Jennifer心灰意冷下決定絕跡蘭桂坊事隔八個月,二人重遇,Steven更希望能夠與她發展,可惜

programme.title: 美人草普
programme.desc: 1974年夏天,昆明知青葉星雨在回兵團連隊的路上邂逅了一生難忘的男人,北京知青劉思蒙星雨青梅竹馬的男朋友袁定國是她所在連隊的排長在紅春坪的集市上定國和思蒙發生了激烈的武裝衝突多情的星雨成了兩個團知青武鬥的導火索

programme.title: 賭聖3之無名小子粵普
programme.desc: 孤兒無名和失明的模特兒苦兒相愛,無名憑精湛賭術打出名堂,但卻遭好友駿背叛,被打至瞎眼,只好隱居退出江湖,過著潦倒的生活苦兒接受眼角膜手術後回復視覺並尋到無名,無名決重出江湖誓與駿決一死戰,就算犧牲苦兒也在所不計

programme.title: 決戰江陵韓
programme.desc: 韓國江陵市最大的犯罪集團老大計劃建造亞洲最大的度假村他最受信任的手下吉石過著舒適的生活,每天執行老大的任務,對他忠心耿耿敏錫是來自首爾的年輕黑幫老大,有頭腦和野心,決定跳槽從事度假事業,建立自己的勢力敏錫以各種暴力和詐欺手段獲得了度假村,導致吉石的幫派處於危險中,於是吉石決定展開復仇

programme.title: 我要結婚粵普
programme.desc: 細妹年近三十仍在街市賣魚且單身,身旁親友都望她能嫁得金龜婿在一次機遇中,細妹偶遇富家公子CHRIS,CHRIS驚覺細妹與其失蹤了的前女友LINDA外貌極似,故向她展開追求,並有意娶她進門

programme.title: 我要結婚粵普
programme.desc: 細妹年近三十仍在街市賣魚且單身,身旁親友都望她能嫁得金龜婿在一次機遇中,細妹偶遇富家公子CHRIS,CHRIS驚覺細妹與其失蹤了的前女友LINDA外貌極似,故向她展開追求,並有意娶她進門

programme.title: 老虎田雞粵普
programme.desc: 老虎受一老婦所托,要尋回並丈夫田雞田雞正在賭場搏殺,不幸被女扒手插贓嫁禍,田雞在賭場大打出手,最後逃到扒手家扒手誘他脫衣取回贓款更騙走他的鐵布衫田雞被老婆鎖進柴房老虎往救之,但取回寶衣後,利益三七分帳就在此時,女扒手派殺手欲置田雞於死地

programme.title: 地下室驚魂普
programme.desc: 故事發生在一時尚現代感的別墅地下室,好奇心極重的網絡小說作家那遙與網名為大風的性格內向,不善表達的IT精英王東相識於網絡為了尋找創作靈感,她應邀住進了王東家的地下室入住後,卻發現王東有不同的人格狀態那遙和她的瘋狂熱情粉絲嚴鵬開始尋根究底,一起讓人意外的事件終於浮出水面

programme.title: 追擊8月15粵普
programme.desc: 探員何若智意外認識了少女陳美玲(蔡卓妍飾),玲原是來自未來的機械人,她回到過去是為了確保50年後的科學偉人晶片之父何小明的親哥哥要在八月十五日死去,因為晶片之父是因為那天哥哥離世而發憤圖強,並根據自己妻子的樣子研究出陳美玲機械人,而智正是晶片之父的親哥哥

programme.title: 愛得起粵普
programme.desc: 麗娜(梁詠琪 飾) 終於決定離婚了麗娜幾乎巳經忘記了一年前為甚麼要嫁給曉東(邵兵 飾),甚至想不起自己曾經愛上曉東那些優點

programme.title: 每天愛您8小時粵普
programme.desc: 張叔偉是廣告界天才橫溢的創作主任,也是成功的形象設計師,每次他發掘和塑造的女郎成為廣告明星後,他都會愛上自己親手創造出來的傑作可惜,每一次到了最後,卻都會被名成利就的傑作所拋棄偉在一次廣告拍攝時,發現了前來做特模特兒的徐若瑄,她獨有的氣質和爽朗開放的性格,由第一眼望見她就開始愛上了她

programme.title: 瘦虎肥龍粵普
programme.desc: 肥龍和瘦虎是一對嫉惡如仇的警探,二人在追捕毒販太子德時,毀了副警務署長的婚禮,只好離港消上司之氣二人在新加坡認識了兩女子在此時,犯人被保外出,聘請殺手幹掉二人,二人機智脫險,二人苦無證據控告太子德,惟有以暴易暴

programme.title: 消失的她普
programme.desc: 富商何非和妻子李木子在一週年結婚紀念日時,雙雙前往東南亞國家巴蘭迪亞(虛構國家,官方語言為馬來語和泰語)旅行,但木子卻在某天晚上離開度假別墅後離奇消失妻子人間蒸發兩星期的何非面臨簽證將到期,當地警方也拒予以立案,只有華裔警官鄭成現身表示能提供幫助焦慮不安的何非回別墅醉酒一晚,隔天一早在床上醒來,身邊卻出現一名素昧平生,卻聲稱自己就是木子的陌生女人儘管何非向鄭成否認眼前的陌生女人是木子,

programme.title: 玉女添丁粵普
programme.desc: 安份守已無甚大志的廣告公司小祕書周麗娟,被挑剔的女上司Monica無理解僱為求保住飯碗,麗娟竟然假裝未婚有孕,公司基於保護孕婦僱員條例收回了解僱信

programme.title: 愛與誠粵普
programme.desc: 就與進是一對自小與外婆相依為命的兄弟,但就於進八歲時便已離開家門,還拿了家中的五萬元出走,之後音訊全無進對於其兄就離開一直念念不忘,之後方知就於泰國成為黑道中人,加上外婆的死去

programme.title: 花旗少林粵普
programme.desc: 美藉華人幹探張正(周潤發飾)身手不凡,在一次救人質的計劃中表現出色,獲上司賞識,派往中國協助運送一件寶物回美國,他來到武林聖地少林寺等候總部指示,在此結識了身懷絕技的少女小菁(吳倩蓮飾),並被其撲朔迷離的身世吸引,惟任務背後隱藏殺機,原來小菁正是眾人虎視眈眈的寶物

programme.title: 那一夜母親是殺人犯日
programme.desc: 十五年前,稻村家的母親為了三個子女的幸福將來,狠心殺死總是藉酒施暴的一家之主,那一夜,一家人的命運從此被改變,兄妹三人從此走上截然不同的人生次男雄二,事件之後遠赴東京,一心追逐記者夢,卻也只能在雜誌社打工勉強糊口長子大樹從小就因為口吃而不擅與人溝通,目前與妻子分居,爭奪女兒的監護權中妹妹園子因為被貼上殺人犯女兒的標籤,不得不放棄成為美髮師的夢想,而在酒吧打工十五年後,母親刑滿依約回到

programme.title: 但願有情人粵普
programme.desc: 兩個各不相干的男女,因緣際遇地結識,從而彼此激烈相愛,引發出一段非一般的愛情故事,相愛玫死亦今生無悔nn一個自少沉淪黑道, 終日與黑人物為伍, 本性雖善良但卻難被社會所接受 另一個為富家小姐, 自少深得萬般寵愛, 完全生活在最好的環境下, 溫室的小花朵!

programme.title: 烈日當空粵普
programme.desc: 2007年,世界忙於迎接08奧運大事,香港學生最重視的戰役--中五會考在即,九個少年男女卻茫然站在成人與小孩的關卡,於網絡,短訊,物慾橫流的虛擬與殘酷現實中進退失據;躁動又脆弱的心靈惺惺相惜

programme.title: 後備甜心粵普
programme.desc: 在情人心中只佔第二位置的Jill相信終有一天能成為正印,直至她發現當志安和女友分手後卻另結新歡,她開始感到迷茫當Jack發現女友Grace原來有一個七年的男朋友,也同樣感到無助得到上司Jason點破後,兩個同病相憐的人得以冰釋前嫌變成朋友,一起互相扶持,誓要為自己的愛情力爭到底

programme.title: 天之書
programme.desc: 世界陷入無盡黑暗,人們在大漠深處的地宮中發現一本遠古天之書,傳說擁有者可掌握乾坤。各路探險者紛紛前往,當地宮陰門大開,異象頻生,隊伍接連遭遇危險,而更大的危機正逐步逼近……

programme.title: Hide and Seek
programme.desc: 十三年前,廢棄大廈的一場爆炸奪走了童的好友諾安。十三年後,童與昔日的朋友們重返故地,此地如今已成為他們就讀的大學校園。當一名與諾安容貌相同的女孩出現,兒時的遊戲化為索命的詛咒。復仇的惡靈再度甦醒,逐一

programme.desc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。

programme.desc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。

programme.title: 開棺
programme.desc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。

programme.title: Guns of Eden
programme.desc: 前水牛城女警Megan與友人到深山露營時,意外目睹當地警長以私刑處決毒販。事跡敗露後,警長為滅口,竟將他們列為追殺目標。眾人試圖逃離,卻發現所有下山路徑已被封死。為徹底掩蓋罪行,警長公然調動私人武裝民

programme.title: 狄仁傑之通天謎案
programme.desc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。

programme.desc: 傑米的妻子在車禍中不幸喪生的一年後,他游說妻子的妹妹與他一起返回事故現場,進行一場古怪的儀式。隨著夜幕低垂,傑米明顯有行兇的動機。

programme.title: 替身紙人
programme.desc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。

programme.title: Mama Ghost
programme.desc: 在一個沿海小鎮,Rico與Sisca發展了一段不可能的戀情,卻因他們相愛而引發惡靈的出現。隨著整個城鎮發生連串駭人聽聞的死亡事件,也揭露了隱藏多年的秘密,使到整個城鎮被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需

programme.title: 夜迷藏
programme.desc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: 一位渴望成名的作家決心撰寫一部暢銷小說來挽救自己的事業。他重返童年居所,這裡也是他成功作家父親神秘離世的地方。當他發現父親的最後手稿時,才意識到這部作品遠超出他的能力。因此,他決定抄襲這份作品,卻隨即

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個冰淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…

programme.title: Red Rain (AKA Love Rain)
programme.desc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。

programme.title: 冥婚
programme.desc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密

programme.title: 模範家庭 #1
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開

programme.title: 模範家庭 #2
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。

programme.title: 7ujuh (aka 7Seven: A Vengeful Suri)
programme.desc: 7個朋友踏上旅程,前往村長和女兒Suri經營的偏遠平房。他們舉行派對,並請求Suri擔任侍應。隨著派對逐漸失控,Suri不幸遭強暴。在自殺前,她對這7個人施下咒怨,使他們受到惡夢的纏擾。隨著這7人一個

programme.title: 凌晨三點鐘 - 醫院
programme.desc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈? 在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷

programme.title: Red Rain (AKA Love Rain)
programme.desc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。

programme.title: 包剪石沓
programme.desc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇,三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可,被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象,他們的追女橋段層出不窮,用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方,卻全部失靈,烏龍百出

programme.title: 獵人
programme.desc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事,周丟棄劉明華,又去追獵呂綺美,劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚,呂遭殺死,警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人,一個一個的被殺死,嫌兇漸指向他,好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。

programme.title: 陸小鳳之決戰前後
programme.desc: 兩大武林劍客葉孤城與西門吹雪將於紫禁城決鬥。陸小鳳忖度二人素末謀面,又無利益衝突,無須決鬥,猜想當中一定事有蹊蹺。於是,他決定和花滿樓前往京城調查清楚,卻發現當中隱藏的陰謀…

programme.title: 人蛇鼠
programme.desc: 莊家農場獨子莊士德海外歸來,接手由胡麟管理的產業。胡一直與德之表妹曼玲勾結,圖取莊家產業,並欲利用曼玲美色迷惑德!怎知在阿芬飼養的小蛇「西西」幫助下,反令德與芬結成夫婦。後來胡買來一條專咬人的野老鼠,欲將德之初生嬰兒咬死,「西西」為救嬰兒,與野鼠作殊死搏鬥

programme.title: 廣東十虎與後五虎
programme.desc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰,在賭館當巡場;一夜,十虎的徒弟及後人等四人,在賭場相聚時,旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲,把譚聰殺死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等,昔日曾把父殺死,以助反清義士蔡民義脫險。小虎遂與師叔們聯手,殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人,為父報仇

programme.title: 乾隆下江南
programme.desc: 乾隆為體察民情,撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南,期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓,導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年,二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後,青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。

programme.title: 賣命小子
programme.desc: 武林名門世家子弟袁鷹飛為了對付虎威鏢局少鏢頭關雲,拉攏四位失意江湖高手對付他。豈料四人與關雲不打不相識,反成好友。後袁鷹飛設下毒計害死關雲,四人悲憤交集,遂聯手為友復仇。

programme.title: 春暖花開
programme.desc: 故事描述,陳太太有女潔玉及美玉,潔玉已工作,美玉仍求學。適逢陳家有空房出租,少奇來租,一談即合;潔玉三個姊姊,皆與租客結婚,所以潔玉表姊趙靜蘭之母決仿效陳家租房選婿。未幾,一醫科學生欣農來租房,趙母見他是理想快婿,忙出租。原來少奇與欣農是同學,少奇老成寡言,被潔玉、美玉視為怪人,欣農則只顧談戀愛…

programme.title: 奪魂鈴
programme.desc: 故事描述,少年衛虎家遭左景龍、應天與楊剛所洗劫,父母幼弟被殺,姊衛芸被左劫走,頓時家破人亡。虎憤恨萬狀,放火燒毀家園,決心遠走天涯,找尋仇人報復;虎流浪各地,遇隱名大俠士,投拜為師,數年即習藝有成,遂往找仇人;虎抵雞兒鎮,遇弱女香香遭逼為娼,逐出手相助,擊退歹徒

programme.title: 文素臣
programme.desc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察,他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按,幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇,林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺,聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。

programme.title: 落葉飛刀
programme.desc: 日本財閥小川,為奪燕姓所有之森林,勾結劣紳關甫淩,屢次對森林主人燕劍光遊說,均被拒絕。小川收買燕家內侄徐千偷取燕老鑰匙,潛入密室,盜取地契。後被燕老發覺,徐千竟將燕老痛毆致死。關甫淩有女月花,與燕家小主人子飛,本有嫁娶之約,燕老死後,但鑑於其父與日人相勾結,國恨家仇,兒女私情無法兼顧,只得示意決絕…

programme.title: 魔界
programme.desc: 故事講述,警局偵緝部情侶探員鄭忠與王麗芬同往離島露營,半夜麗芬忽聞異聲,離營探看,突見綠光一閃,隨即著魔。翌日,王警官率眾處理一宗挾持人質案件,期間麗芬逕自開槍射殺劫匪,過程被雜誌記者阿古攝得,發現子彈竟能轉向殺人

programme.title: 玉面飛狐
programme.desc: 玉面閻羅夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局金婁文之義子,後司馬鏢因偷取兩本功夫秘笈而傷夏之臉,並將師父殺死;夏抱初生女兒逃走。夏抱女入山修練,並傳武藝予女兒玉面飛狐,命她出山向司馬劫鏢報仇。後飛狐遭司馬擒住,幸為書生徐繩所救。飛狐回山后,父疑心其與徐有私情,把她關在地窟中

programme.title: 萬花迎春
programme.desc: 歌舞團台柱陳君邁賦閒多時後,應徵當富家女梅倩如的司機,竟被誤傳戀情。倩如為查明流言的來源,假扮記者採訪歌舞團,期間君邁與倩如暗生好感,經過一番試探後,二人終一舞定情。

programme.title: 少林五祖
programme.desc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷,處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟,於是火燒少林寺。事出突然,寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九。其中五名生還弟子,決意為死去的少林弟子報仇。五人潛心修煉終成正果,被後世稱為“少林五祖”。

programme.title: 少林五祖
programme.desc: 將少林寺視為眼中釘的清廷,處心積慮地想一舉消滅少林子弟,於是火燒少林寺。事出突然,寺中僧人及俗家弟子十死其九。其中五名生還弟子,決意為死去的少林弟子報仇。五人潛心修煉終成正果,被後世稱為“少林五祖”。

programme.title: 盜兵符
programme.desc: 本片是一部戰國時代歷史武俠片。故事描述,秦攻魏鄰趙國,魏信陵君與朱亥為救國,代魏王妃嬪如姬報父仇,以請姬盜魏王兵符,發兵救趙

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍,啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍,而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是,此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技,二人皆為深不可測的武林高手!

programme.title: 金菩薩
programme.desc: 陳氏家族失落的家傳之寶「金菩薩」隱藏了藏寶地點,秘密分別刻在三尊金菩薩內。保險員保羅意外地得到一尊金菩薩,另一尊則落在陳氏女兒美蘭手上。非法奪寶集團為尋寶藏下落追殺二人。保羅和美蘭為查明藏寶地點,歷盡艱辛,合力對抗,最終智破寶藏之謎,更勇破非法集團奪產的陰謀。

programme.title: 玉女嬉春
programme.desc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已。

programme.title: 唐人街功夫小子
programme.desc: 青年譚東獨自從大陸來港投靠祖父,因與黑社會人物徐豪結怨而遭陷害,迫於無奈偷渡到三藩市。東在唐人街飯店覓得工作,後來又因打抱不平而再牽涉入黑幫恩怨中。東更重遇徐豪,二人展開連場惡戰。

programme.title: 江山美人

programme.title: 不羈尚比亞 #3 英普
programme.desc: 隨著旱季開始,成千上萬的動物正前往相思環每頭動物都必須在捕食順序中確立自己的位置,避免那些非常願意以粗心的動物作大餐的危險居民

programme.title: 不羈尚比亞 #4 英普
programme.desc: 毛拉是麥茲家族中最年輕的小牛隨著氣溫飆升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭逼使毛拉和牠的家人進行一次漫長而危險的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源:盧安瓜河

programme.title: 怪奇「物」語 #2
programme.desc: 一些外貌最奇特的鳥類都是驚人的倖存者一個快跑者,一個潮流指標,一個清道夫,一個花花公子和一個浪漫人士這些有翅怪物證明除了外表,牠們還有很多東西令你詫異

programme.title: 馬拉威野生拯救隊 #5

programme.title: 明猩學園 #3
programme.desc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性領袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險

programme.title: 野性菲律賓 #1
programme.desc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚

programme.title: 野性菲律賓 #2
programme.desc: 潛入清澈見底的海洋,探索圖巴塔哈礁,這片礁體坐落在一座已熄滅的海底火山之上;那裡的淺潟湖庇護著海龜與鼬鯊也與眼鏡猴一同騰躍飛掠,看牠們靠著樹木之間強而有力的跳躍來獵捕昆蟲

programme.title: 動物朋友仔 #3
programme.desc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一頭被救出的犀牛孤兒跟一隻貪玩的小狗和一隻充滿愛的綿羊成為朋友,一隻大兔子照料一頭精力旺盛的小羊,還有一隻箭豬幫助兩隻英國鬥牛犬為受傷動物復健

programme.title: 風之島 #1 英普
programme.desc: 亞拉國家公園中陰暗的森林,對行縱隱密的豹來說是完美的藏身之所;而年輕的䧳豹阿莎亦準備好獨自闖蕩一起見證她爭奪自己的領地,尋找伴侶,到成為母親的歷程

programme.desc: 了解南美洲多變的氣候如何孕育更豐富多樣的生命尋找亞馬遜雨林中能夠「呼吸」氧氣的樹木,追隨廣闊的雲河軌跡,並拜會能在猛烈紫外線下茁壯成長的紅鶴

programme.title: 野性菲律賓 #1
programme.desc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚

programme.title: 野性菲律賓 #2
programme.desc: 潛入清澈見底的海洋,探索圖巴塔哈礁,這片礁體坐落在一座已熄滅的海底火山之上;那裡的淺潟湖庇護著海龜與鼬鯊也與眼鏡猴一同騰躍飛掠,看牠們靠著樹木之間強而有力的跳躍來獵捕昆蟲

programme.title: 怪奇「物」語 #1
programme.desc: 我們在本集探索一種非常奇怪的植物和四種獨特的動物,牠們在世上留下深刻的痕跡,只因牠們非常臭,並有糟糕的廁所禮儀

programme.title: 非洲視「野」 #2
programme.desc: 納米比沙漠是最極端的地方,由冰洋到黃沙,需要驚人的堅韌和適應力才能生存,只有特別存在的少數能做到由響尾蝰蛇到納米比沙漠甲蟲,每種動物都為求存而各顯神通

programme.title: 非洲視「野」 #3
programme.desc: 納米比沙漠是世上最古老的沙漠,擁有超過400公里的非洲海岸線,也是地球上最荒涼的棲息地之一但世界上最大的陸地哺乳類竟然在這裡紮根,透過改變行為來適應極端的生活

programme.title: 野外的一年:大西洋 #2
programme.desc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢

programme.title: 野外的一年:大西洋 #3
programme.desc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食,長大並準備自立對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍

programme.desc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴,苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海探索成年雄鹿,青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #3
programme.desc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #4
programme.desc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激:徵服壯麗塔特拉山,漂流急湍河道,探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #5
programme.desc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪,雪車衝刺,盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻--還有神秘魔法驚喜!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #6
programme.desc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決,傳統舞蹈,《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #5
programme.desc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭,其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #6
programme.desc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義

programme.title: 基努李維:獨一無二
programme.desc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月,多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在

programme.title: 內馬爾:巴西頭號射手
programme.desc: 從山度士街頭到成為巴西隊頭號射手,內馬爾20年的歷程值得載入史冊內馬爾幾乎在每個大洲都踢過足球,他將永遠成為球壇的傳說

programme.title: 傑拉德:神奇隊長
programme.desc: 傑拉德在長達20多年的輝煌職業生涯中體驗並成功晉身球壇巔峰,作為球員和教練捧起過獎盃,又代表過國家隊但有高山就會伴隨低谷

programme.title: 足球金童:C羅
programme.desc: 從年輕的葡萄牙神童開始見證有史以來最偉大的球員之一的旅程這是絕無僅有的基斯坦勞朗拿度

programme.title: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc: Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye She packs her bags and sets off nnNew York’s signature street food is the hot dog In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc: The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries nnHere is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets nnThis episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world

programme.title: 時光之輪 # 1
programme.desc: 一名神祕的貴族女子來到偏遠的山中村落,聲稱五名年輕人之中,有一人是曾毀滅世界,如今轉世重生的遠古力量;若無法及時找出真相,世界將再次走向毀滅然而,他們所剩的時間比想像中更少

programme.title: 時光之輪 # 2
programme.desc: 莫瑞恩與蘭帶領四名村民逃離險境,卻無法確定誰才是預言中的那一位但這群朋友同樣對拯救他們的人心存疑慮,尤其當他們見識到莫瑞恩為完成使命願意付出的代價,以及蘭可能引領他們走向多麼危險的道路

programme.title: 時光之輪 # 3
programme.desc: 莫瑞恩與蘭在一個意想不到,甚至不受歡迎的對象身上獲得協助;而分散的村民則試圖彼此尋回,或至少找到避難之所然而,他們很快發現黑暗之王的勢力觸及之廣,以及在旅途中能信任的人是多麼稀少

programme.title: 時光之輪 # 4
programme.desc: 莫瑞恩在不確定中掙扎,蘭則對新同伴充滿疑慮蘭德掛念著馬特,而馬特也開始對自己產生疑問艾雯與佩林踏上截然不同的道路,一股驚人的新力量被釋放到世界之中

programme.title: 時光之輪 # 5
programme.desc: 佩林與艾雯遇見一張熟悉的面孔;馬特與蘭德則看見詭異的陌生人莫瑞恩與蘭為失去的同伴哀悼

programme.title: 時光之輪 # 6
programme.desc: 沐蘭正面臨她行為所帶來的後果麥特正視自己內心的黑暗艾雯則要面對世界上最有權勢的女人

programme.title: 時光之輪 # 7
programme.desc: 沐蘭和她的隨從們因為一場意外的遭遇而偏離了原定的路徑然而,這次轉向揭露了許多事情--沐蘭的真實目標,嵐的過去,團隊中日益增長的裂痕,以及轉生真龍的身分

programme.title: 時光之輪 # 8
programme.desc: 二十年來,沐蘭一直夢想並致力於這一刻但她無法阻止轉生真龍看見黑暗勢力的誘惑力

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從靈界迷惑到真相大白

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 香港的驕傲粵
我們的主題曲粵
programme.desc: TVB眾多英雄故事劇集，向不同崗位的英勇人士致敬。紀律部隊題材深入民心，威利高歌<胸懷大志；胡渭康偕黃奕斌、孫漢霖演繹<伴我啟航，再三回味《新紮師兄》。民初劇歌頌昔日英雄，為葉振棠度「聲」訂造的《蘇乞兒》主題曲，如何讓聲線投入其中？人民律師為正義發聲，《壹號皇庭》系列叫好叫座。蘇永康、林君蓮合唱新版插曲<假使有日能忘記。王梓軒聯同何雁詩、龔柯允等唱將，在戶外清新帶來<女黑俠木蘭花等佳作。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#131粵
programme.desc: 亨回鄉被親人奶爸迫婚，要他娶富家女亞美娜，亨跳海逃婚。娜追蹤而至，麗自認是亨的妻子。奶爸提議進行三局比賽決定亨誰屬。第一局麗敵不過以本傷人的亞美娜，第二局運蛋比賽中麗更打翻整盤雞蛋，之後竟有奇跡出現。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#6粵普PG
programme.desc: 有人送玉如意進宮，太后收到後勃然大怒；姑娘們提起三百忠魂之事，心有餘悸。謝危要雪寧留下來練琴，藉此試探她救鄭保一事。姚惜得知父親主動向張家提親，向雪寧道謝。雪寧偶然聽到謝危談論玉如意的事，卻被他發現。

programme.title: 香港本色粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 木偶可以變得有生命並演繹不同角色，全靠木偶師一雙巧手。「提線木偶戲」是偶戲中歷史最為悠久的，每個木偶最少有十六條線，若表演時出現繞線情況，偶戲大師黃暉會如何掩飾如此尷尬的場面？「掌中木偶戲」、「皮影戲」、「杖頭木偶戲」有何相異之處？木偶除了演出不同神話、寓言故事外，同樣可參演「手托木偶粵劇」。節目走進後台，欣賞各木偶師演出時的功架；手托木偶粵劇團團長陳錦濤還帶大家認識現已「過百歲」的花旦。

programme.title: 食平DD粵
programme.desc: 今集跟肥媽學煮茶餐廳小食。沙爹牛肉是茶餐廳招牌菜，沙爹醬起了一錘定音的作用，肥媽用三種常見的調味料，就煮到美味的沙爹牛肉。肥媽傳授炒蛋變滑竅門。肥媽改良芒果腸粉這道甜品，賣相和做法有何分別？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 寒背可分為A形與B形，前者多與退化有關，常見於長者；後者則常出現在青年及成年人身上，或因日常不良姿勢所引起。長期寒背不僅影響外觀，更可能導致肩頸痛、集中力下降等。脊醫帶來簡易檢測，並介紹輔助矯正用品，還會示範改善運動。當局推動「社區藥房」計劃，希望為市民提供一個可接觸、可諮詢、可跟進的藥劑服務點。參與計劃的藥劑師前來，介紹社區藥房的定位與服務內容。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅示範「火焰鐵板咕嚕金球」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 鼻咽位於鼻腔的深入位置，一旦有異甚難察覺。張達明憶述曾隔幾日流幾滴鼻血，經檢查確診鼻咽癌。七年抗癌路，他以甚麼為動力撐過？醫生一般採用電療與化療醫治鼻咽癌，質子治療如何優化療程？鼻咽癌復發率不低，「內電」療法又怎樣做到快狠準去打擊癌細胞？相對全球人士，為何廣東人患這症的風險會較高？另外，結合超聲波與磁力共振技術，大大提升檢測前列腺癌的準確度！就着前列腺健康，營養師特地帶來「番茄白磨菇三文魚」食譜。

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#13粵PG
programme.desc: 高哲約江揚飲酒，江揚問高哲為何可以原諒殺父仇人，高哲解釋其理念。蓉蓉參加了心理座談會，終解開心中疑慮。蓉蓉幪眼參與心理遊戲時遇上刻意找她的高哲，高哲向蓉蓉表達好感，蓉蓉的反應令他以為被拒。大海因已逝女友阿美的智障妹妹麗麗被鄭偉成性侵犯，不斷自責。江揚遇未被入罪的偉成，刻意踢他一腳，翌日卻被投訴將偉成打至遍體鱗傷。美莉被誤會在名店偷竊，君豪助解圍，二人晚膳後君豪送她回家，被江揚發現，兩夫妻又起爭執。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子的學校有一個叫「跨級好朋友」的制度，把不同年級的學生配對，共同參與各種學校活動。跟姐姐配對的是一名叫小夏的一年級生，她在言行上處處針對小丸子，彷彿要跟小丸子爭奪妹妹的位置。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 花牌是香港一項非物質文化遺產，其大小、用料、顏色都十分引人注目，可以說是廣告牌的前身。本集「Kids’ Notes」，花牌製作師傅細說這門傳統紮作技藝的變遷。傳統的花牌是用竹製作，師傅卻曾為了迎合安全標準、將工藝帶到海外，改用不鏽鋼及鋁片作「新嘗試」，有何深刻畫面？時代變遷，嘉賓認為花牌也有「進步」，加入LED、3D顯示等元素，變得更吸睛。花牌亦可應用到更多場合與節日，歡迎大家「打卡」留念！

programme.desc: 城安大量入手某款食品，卻因退貨潮陷入危機，可能會失去吳旺達的一切，甚至小Bon亦被收歸國有。城安設法補救，但成效不大。小Bon因遭責罵疑似離家出走，城安遍尋不獲。此時牙斬斬限他兩日內將該款食品「清貨」，凌凌等人答應幫忙並尋找小Bon。其後，城安於住所發現小Bon，原想告知眾人，卻得知退貨已清掉，遂請他們協助處理餘下存貨，因而隱瞞小Bon已尋回，並將牠安置別處，怎料小Bon再次失蹤……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 峨眉派於武俠小說享負盛名，女俠「郭襄」在男性主導的江湖中闖出一片天！兩師兄弟登上峨眉山金頂，試試「代入」其開宗創派心態。現實中的峨眉武術起源更悠久，而且男女弟子皆收，二人直擊流派所在地，一探剛柔並濟、快慢兼備的拳術與槍法精髓。峨眉山腳有一隱世小鎮，主持們放慢節奏，感受田園詩意。接着深入威士忌酒廠，見識價值不菲的銅壺蒸餾設備，淺酌三款原酒。「怪味」牛肩肉、威士忌醬肉等精緻料理，更將美酒佳餚完美結合！

programme.desc: 寒背可分為A形與B形，前者多與退化有關，常見於長者；後者則常出現在青年及成年人身上，或因日常不良姿勢所引起。長期寒背不僅影響外觀，更可能導致肩頸痛、集中力下降等。脊醫帶來簡易檢測，並介紹輔助矯正用品，還會示範改善運動。當局推動「社區藥房」計劃，希望為市民提供一個可接觸、可諮詢、可跟進的藥劑服務點。參與計劃的藥劑師前來，介紹社區藥房的定位與服務內容。「睇餸食飯」，李偉強師傅示範「火焰鐵板咕嚕金球」。

programme.title: 食平DD粵
programme.desc: 肥媽分別用燒、蒸、煮、煎四種方法炮製鱸魚、紅衫魚、黃魚、花膠仔，做法簡單，不消十分鐘就完成。只要準備好黑朱古力、鮮奶、忌廉等在超市可買的材料，便可做出軟滑的朱古力慕絲，且看肥媽教路。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 胰臟是個同時有內分泌與外分泌的器官，發炎可能因膽石或飲酒過量，抽驗胰臟酵素就可對病情略知一二。外科醫生細說這炎症的紓緩治療；如由膽石引致，醫生建議切除膽囊，有何原因？「枕神經痛」與普遍頭痛的分別在哪裡？不良姿勢長期壓逼枕後神經是主因，發作時如大力按壓反會加劇疼痛！糾正姿勢和多做強化、放鬆運動有助改善狀況，留意註冊物理治療師傳授相關動作。打邊爐吃剩響鈴？「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨示範「番茄響鈴蝦滑卷湯」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 心臟在結構、運作上均是複雜的器官，急性心肌梗塞更是致命疾病，胸口痛、呼吸困難、飆汗是徵狀，但原來胃部不適、消化不良是非典型病徵。兩位急性心肌梗塞康復者述說當時病況，二人都非完成一次手術便一勞永逸，還會牽引出甚麼心血管問題？醫生介紹相關的檢查與手術新技術，並提醒「三低一高零反式」的飲食習慣可大大預防發病機會！此外，健身教練向主持宋宛穎、魏韵芝傳授三個中等程度的強心動作；體內的膽固醇水平又可怎樣減低？

programme.desc: Mia與虹豆沙湯遠有緣，似是命中注定的一對，樹仁得悉此事，鼓勵沙湯遠追求她。因鐵面陳之故，沙湯遠本來不敢有非分之想，但與Mia經常相遇，不禁產生情愫，鐵面陳亦察覺異樣。沙湯遠向鐵面陳坦言愛上Mia，提出公平競爭，鐵面陳卻使陰招對付他……沙湯遠提出決鬥爭奪Mia，舉行前卻生變故，鐵面陳因某些原因遇襲，沙湯遠前來相救，結果同告受傷。Mia於關鍵時刻現身幫忙，眾人合力趕走施襲者，沙湯遠此時卻發現……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#5粵PG
programme.desc: 嘉儀發現殺害嘉嵐的兇手之際，卻被注射迷暈針。嘉儀醒來後嘗試偷走……家俊利用手機追蹤程式找到嘉儀，帶她逃離凶險，就在此時，關鍵人物拿着鐵鎚衝入欲斬家俊，危急關頭美雅以身阻擋。嘉儀欲離港逃難，但家俊想到美雅的安危，勸嘉儀不要離港，決定二人從今一起生活，共同面對今後的困難。嘉儀感動答應，此時看到新聞畫面，報道稱殺嘉嵐真兇終於落網……

programme.title: 食玩假期呈獻：江湖見粵
programme.desc: 黎耀祥、麥包在街邊想吃燃麵之際，竟聽到「大師兄」陳浩民的聲音！浩民指當年已看好黎耀祥會奪獎，卻看漏了麥包的潛力？浩民除扮演孫悟空外，也演過哪吒，師弟們遂帶他往宜賓市的翠屏山哪吒行宮走一趟，拜一拜，他亦回想廿多年來在性格心態上的變化。白酒是宜賓的靈魂與驕傲，除了高梁，當地釀酒還加入大米、小麥、糯米和粟米。三人試過原漿酒，再淺酌調教過的白酒，特別舒暢。當年浩民接張衛健的棒子演孫悟空，其實心情如何？

programme.title: 女法醫解密#15粵普PG
programme.desc: 秦莞檢驗一被剝皮男屍，屍體上的硃砂痕跡令燕遲想到幾年前的觀音鎮殺人案，此案曾被沈毅列為疑案。他們提審當年疑犯張洞玄，聽說了天道社的事。查到死者身分後他們找其兄了解情況，其後又找上染墨畫館寧不易查問。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
獵鷹#13粵
programme.desc: 戚幹被迫遷，趁機對江霞藉詞已無屋住，欲入住江家，江霞詐作不明其意，戚幹幾經辛苦一再暗示求婚，江霞才願意付託終身。婚事傳開，眾人都替江霞高興，江霞感溫暖幸福，戚幹卻不勝其煩。戚幹提早遷入江家，但江霞諸多管束，戚幹感猶如坐牢。結婚前夕，戚幹與照等出外玩樂，照苦訴婚姻生活，戚幹頓生恐懼。結婚當日，戚幹喝至酩酊大醉，延誤結婚時間，江霞質問戚幹有否誠意，戚幹坦言恐懼婚姻，江霞傷心大哭，戚幹頹然離去。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 心臟病患者免疫力較弱，一旦患上肺炎等疾病，更要謹慎治療。心臟科醫生提醒如出現異常氣喘、心跳異常等，應立即求醫。醫生又指心臟病人感染肺炎的治療難度相當高，因此建議接種肺炎球菌疫苗，以減低感染風險。有襲擊人類前科的犬隻常被判定不適合領養，甚至面臨人道毀滅。動物救援團體創辦人希望助牠們改善問題，並物色合適的新主人。他到來受訪，並分享救助這些犬隻的深刻點滴。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅示範「田雞腿焗飯」。

programme.title: 早D知早D醫粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿是痛風患者，起初是因腳拇趾出現腫痛而發現。諾懿提到患上痛風與其愛喝酒跟打邊爐的飲食習慣有關；營養師帶來選擇嘌呤食物建議。風濕病科醫生稱痛風有年輕化趨勢，並示範檢查方法與詳析治療資訊；中醫師則有舒緩痛症的自製「法寶」。腎病專科醫生指如出現腳腫、血尿、蛋白尿，都是慢性腎衰竭的病徵。前藝人陳存正是慢性腎衰竭患者，她接受永城訪問，訴說患病與治療經歷。醫生另細述慢性腎病的醫療詳情，洗肚與洗血有何不同？

programme.title: 原來愛上賊#15粵PG
programme.desc: 江揚及高哲合力擊斃賊人，但江揚亦中槍。蓉蓉不滿英杰疏忽照顧兒子。高哲答應助她爭撫養權。賊人交給君豪的只是假貨，英杰向君豪表示交易當日才交出真貨，君豪決心找人偷天換日，從遠處監視的高哲知兩人不和。美莉偷銀包後遇君豪，她不斷飲酒，君豪帶她上酒店房間休息，君豪助手向他展示美莉偷竊過程。英杰帶貨交易途中，在升降機內被君豪的手下掉包，高哲及譚彬最終取走真貨。英杰、君豪和買家交易時被警方人贓並獲。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#133粵
programme.desc: 溢速遞郵件時遇佻皮女孩彤，在彤前表演雜技，彤大喜，竟尾隨他。彤母親秋竟要求溢暫時照顧彤，溢只好帶彤回家。彤突然暈倒。原來她患有白血病，來港目的是找尋適合的骨髓，高家決定令彤能成為她夢寐以求的節目嘉賓。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 張遮設局找出栽贓之人，太后突然改變態度，只因認出那是薛姝的人。雪寧從芷衣處得知薛姝見過沈玠的手帕，便明白自己被陷害的原因。燕牧拜謝謝危救命之恩，言語間提及與外甥定非的過往，二人都未明說，但心意已通曉。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 何遠東駕駛「降魔的」，聯同史學專家施志明講解「蕉林」、「十三座」、「雞寮」實指地點。梁嘉琪全神演繹「失常女神」，與「火水哥」合演瘋狂趣劇，探究「發狼戾」、「斷片」、「跳掣」等港式俗語起源。蜑家人以艇為家，艇上「打仔」當然「飛唔得上灘」！黃沙蜆被奉為新會石板沙三寶之一，眾人實地講解與「蜆」有關的歇後語。「麻煩導演」來到順德逢簡水鄉拍攝音樂電影，被「龍舟說唱」的民間情懷深深吸引，廖Sir細述箇中特色。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 賭博嗜好衍生不少術語，且聽掌故專家鄭寶鴻細數「割禾青」、「坐定粒六」、「鋪草皮」等俗語的有趣出處。「火水哥」對來自台灣的「Roller女神」余思霆一見傾心，他卻對「森77」、「拍謝」等台式潮語一竅不通，難怪再次淪為情場「魯蛇」！廣州有一諺語「沙灣何，有仔唔憂冇老婆」，顯示沙灣何家的名堂響噹噹。何家「管家」疑似死於非命，真相與當地美食可有關連？銅煲、棉被均是廣州著名工藝，背後又隱藏着哪些㜺鬼歇後語？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂(完)
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 依法相愛吧(完)
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 女神降臨
programme.desc: 【人氣漫畫改編，車銀優搭文佳煐神還原廣受好評！！】國中時因長相不起眼飽受霸凌的任朱靜，掌握化妝技巧後上妝搖身一變成為校園女神。與隱藏著不為人知傷痛的校園男神李修豪及個性直率講義氣的韓書俊，三角戀情一觸即發的一起面對著戀愛、生活帶來的的青春浪漫喜劇。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 戀人的謊言
programme.desc: 舒菲和林菲從小一起長大，姐妹情深，形影不離，在大學期間英年才俊奇然學長喜歡林菲，但林菲對奇然沒有感覺，暗戀奇然的舒菲借用林菲的名字和奇然書信來往，姐妹兩同時進入購物電視台上班，意外發現自己的上司居然是奇然，奇然依然鍾情林菲，舒菲暗戀心情破碎，心思放工作上，偶然結識導演藍天，兩人互生情愫，而林菲職場失意，又得知舒菲當年利用她的名字和奇然書信來往，於是陷害舒菲泄露商業機密，害公司倒閉，舒菲陷入輿論壓力中，藍天陪在舒菲身邊，拆穿林菲的謊言，最後林菲真心悔過，和舒菲和好如初，舒菲也收穫和愛情和事業。

programme.title: Sunny Bunnies: Get Busy - Sunny Bunnies: Get Busy Ep20 - EP120
programme.desc: In a new spin-off series of mini-episodes - ‘Sunny Bunnies Get Busy’ - the characters are on hand to entertain and engage viewers in various colourful and creative activities and inspire children to 'Get Busy'.

programme.title: Giselle and the Green Team - The Case of the Degraded Grassland - EP203
programme.desc: Gisele and her Green Team fight to stop Nick Slick from operating an illegal cattle ranch and draining all of the Earth's resources.

programme.title: Shaq's Garage - The Dog Who Loved Me - EP112
programme.desc: Fleming rescues a puppy and learns how fun it can be to raise a pup.

programme.title: Thomas Edison's Secret Lab - Slime Time It’s Always Sharkest - EP109
programme.desc: When JD uses Angie’s ‘oil slick dissolver’ formula for a slime fight, a wrong ingredient creates a gelatinous Blob monster that threatens to devour the city. While visiting one of Kent’s relatives, the kids come up with a great idea for attracting more tourists to his restaurant - the only catch is that it also attracts a very big shark with very big teeth!

programme.title: Argo's World
programme.desc: Join Marie and Argo in this exciting STEM edutainment mixed-media series as they venture through Cyberspace and make discoveries about the world through historical figures and notable real-world personalities! Special guests include a founding father of the Internet, a NASA astronaut, a top robotics expert, and clever folks from M.I.T!

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: The Fixies
programme.desc: The Fixies follows the comical misadventures of Tom Thomas and his secret friendship with Simka and Nolik, the children of the Fixie family that lives in his apartment. There’s just no end to the troubles Tom Thomas and his Fixie friends get themselves into with all the gadgets and appliances around them!

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Terror Tubes Takedown | Episode 7
programme.desc: The Gang dives headfirst into the Fear Zone - and it’s pure chaos. With Nightmare Mode activated and the Fear Bomb ticking, only faith can light the way.

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | The Breath of Courage | Episode 8
programme.desc: With 60 seconds left, the Fear Bomb ticks toward doom. Kungfuda and God's Gang fight with faith and love - will light prevail or fear win?

programme.title: Gods Gang - Gods Gang - God's Gang | Alien Mayhem! | Episode 1, 2, 3
programme.desc: God’s Gang faces insane challenges - from stopping a mad scientist to battling aliens and saving blue whales.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyson the Tanker refuels Jeremy
programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Tyler the Tyke steals candy
programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Sam the Snowplough clears the streets
programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El desierto
programme.desc: En medio de un desierto abrasador, Chip y los átomos se encontraron con un átomo de tungsteno que les brindó refugio bajo un edificio piramidal que, hasta hacía poco, contaba con un ingenioso sistema de refrigeración por el que circulaba una corriente de amoníaco en su sótano. Pero ahora, el Dr. No ha desviado el flujo de amoníaco para su propio beneficio. Chip descubre el punto donde se desvía el amoníaco y construye una presa que lo devuelve a su curso normal.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Lightning Bolt Blackout
programme.desc: When lightning strikes Academy Island, it causes a power cut. Can the Go Jetters rescue their trapped friends without the power they need to call for Click-ons?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Pan-American Highway, Panama
programme.desc: The team's Pan-American road trip leads them to discover that Glitch is building a road through the Darien Gap. Can they save this important habitat and protect the local sloths?

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - All Tracks Lead to Rome
programme.desc: Thomas is working on the Italian Railway, keen to prove to his new friend Gina that he is an expert in all things Italian.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Treasure
programme.desc: Morris and Pearl have lost one of their medals in the canal. Stanley fishes it out only have the complete collection dropped in. Stanley dons a diver's suit and goes after them.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Pumpkin
programme.desc: Stanley must keep Myrtle's pumpkin safe from Speedy the snail. He builds a series of obstacles and defences to protect it from the tenacious Speedy who tests Stanley's ingenuity.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - Sometimes I Make Cakes
programme.desc: Flipping pancakes, baking cakes, and homemade sauce from the shops, the animals share all the things they love about cooking.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S02 - It's Time to Play Hospitals
programme.desc: When Panda's arm gets a small tear in the park, Gran Gran has a plan to head home and set up a hospital for Panda and JoJo's other toys!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Building Block Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels become architects so they can design, build and bring to life their very own clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Reunion Badge
programme.desc: Duggee hosts a reunion for the first ever Squirrels he looked after. But the first ever Squirrels are older now and very similar to the Squirrels' parents. Does that mean that when the Squirrels are bigger, they will become like their parents, too?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Great Wall of China, China
programme.desc: Glitch and his grimbots have a long race on a very long wall - the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Peas
programme.desc: Two peas perform a happy song.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Lemon
programme.desc: Lemon performs a stand-up routine!

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Hiccup Havoc
programme.desc: Supertato uses his hiccups to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's jam attack.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Dino Danger
programme.desc: A toy dinosaur escapes from its box and scares the Grape Kids.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.desc: Emily worries that she doesn't have a best friend. Soon she realises she's been surrounded by best friends all along.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Solar E-Glitch
programme.desc: After watching a solar eclipse, the team head into space to fix the biggest glitch yet!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Volcanic Island
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is drilling into the ground below the ocean near Academy Island, looking for bubbly mud that is heated up by an underground volcano. Back at the Academy, the Go Jetters have been monitoring the underground volcano and discover that it is showing more activity than usual. This is because Glitch has been drilling into it, and it could mean that the volcano is going to erupt!

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Hollywood, USA
programme.desc: After winning a part in a Hollywood film, Glitch is not happy when he has to work with Kyan to finish a scene.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Joist Hoist
programme.desc: There's a girder out of place on Swoppiton Bridge, and unless Nori can fix it, that bridge is coming down! Luckily, Mojo's got the tops, and Bo's got the skills to help get it done.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Big Top Bo
programme.desc: Tao can't go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo's tops!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Young Veggies: Part 1
programme.desc: Evil Pea tells the story of how she and Supertato first arrived at the supermarket as young veggies, and how a young Supertato helped her freeze the veggie aisle! To be continued...

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Chilli to the Rescue
programme.desc: Chilli becomes Super Chilli as he tries to be a superhero just like Supertato.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - The Monstertato Song
programme.desc: Get your spooky veggie vibe on with this frightfully delightful Halloween track!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - It's Christmas Time Song
programme.desc: Evil Pea is up to her usual mischief as she turns the Supermarket into a Winter Wonderland!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Runner Bean's Sporty Song
programme.desc: Get ready, set, dance in the supermarket aisles with Supertato, Runner Bean and the whole Tato Team! Featuring Nitro from Gladiators.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The River Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right at the other end of the river, and a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat. Good job Duggee has his River badge!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Yoga Badge
programme.desc: It's one of those days. The squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit ... hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic, and Duggee needs to calm them all down. Fortunately, he has his Yoga Badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out! POP! Oh dear, there's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything! Thanks, goodness Duggee has got his torch, and he has torches for everyone.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Let’s play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Mums and Dads
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Hide and Seek
programme.desc: It's time for a family game of hide and seek. Everyone hides, while Bluey counts to twenty, but will she be able to stay focused on the game and not get distracted by all her toys.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Camping
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday, Bluey makes a new friend named called Jean-Luc. Bluey may not understand him, but they find a common language playing and hunting for a wild Daddy pig.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Mount Mumandad
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey have five minutes to bed, just enough time to race to the summit of Mount Mumandad. But for them, facing powerful storms, avalanches and stinky spots will take teamwork.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Piraputanga
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to Bonito in the Amazon rainforest on a global adventure to witness piraputanga, a species of fish, leaping from the water to feed on wild berries in the trees above. Along the way, they meet a troop of brown capuchins.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Purple Swamphen
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout embark on a global adventure in Thailand's wetlands on a mission to discover a way to stop invasive golden apple snails from devouring the vegetation. Along the way, Andy hitches a ride with a bird called a purple swamphen.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur. Her two colleagues die mangled in a lift accident and Inspector Wang is injured at his desk by a

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chan's family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan's daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the "walls"?

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web", spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt "Shaolin Hand Lock" from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow" is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar "Drunken Cat" who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Qing enforcer Luo Yi Hu murders rebel Chen Gui, forcing his wife and daughter Xiao Wei to flee to Guang Long Town. There, mischievous Jia Yu discovers his master's identity as a rebel while helping Xiao Wei. After his loved ones and mentor are killed, Jia Yu sheds his playful ways and seeks vengeance, facing the Qing forces in a final battle.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.
